messages:
Kevin: Quick heads-up — PR #8412 fixes the kv-cache OOM observed on large-batch workload. Need 2x LGTM before cutoff 18:30 PT to include in tonight's hotfix roll. Can people spare a quick review?
Sophia: On my radar, will do a pass in 15. Any smoke instructions?
Kevin: Thanks — run the staging repro with:
```
./scripts/smoke_test --seed 42 --batch 512 --kv-warmup
```
I added a small unit test and a stress harness. Watch staging cluster-ramp in the first 2 mins.
Maria: I can give the second LGTM if Jared signs off on the concurrency change.
Jared: Looking now. Quick question: does this change affect model pinning? I only see runtime patching.
Kevin: No model pinning changes, only KV cache allocation and a guard for async queue growth.
Aisha: I ran the smoke locally, couldn't repro OOM but saw a flake in continuous-batch path — filing a short comment on the PR.
Sophia: Left comments, small nits + one functional suggestion. Will recheck after Kevin's update.
Kevin: pushed a tiny fix addressing Sophia's suggestion (@Sophia thanks). Running CI now.
release-bot: CI status — PR #8412: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration (staging) running — ETA ~3m
Maria: CI looks good so far. I can approve once integration finishes and no mem regression.
Jared: Verified the patch diff, concurrency control looks correct. I'll lgtm after integration green.
release-bot: Integration succeeded — staging tests passed. :tada:
Maria: LGTM
Jared: LGTM
Kevin: Awesome, thank you all! Marking for merge and will monitor rollout. :rocket:
Sophia: Thanks team — will watch logs for the first 30m.
Aisha: Noted, will alert on any OOM spikes.
Kevin: (tagging product) @Ellen-PM FYI rolling hotfix with OOM mitigation, ETA for deploy ~20:00 PT
Ellen-PM: Got it, thx for the heads-up.
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for code review coordination; single-thread continuous messages as per agents.md
